verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We study minimum-error identification of an unknown single-bit Boolean function given black-box (oracle) access with one allowed query. verdicts.title: Boolean algebras, Morita invariance, and the algebraic K-theory of Lawvere theories
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: The algebraic K-theory of Lawvere theories is a conceptual device to elucidate the stable homology of the symmetry groups of algebraic structures such as the permutation groups and the automorphism groups of free groups. verdicts.title: Test ideals via algebras of $p^{-e}$-linear maps
verdicts.abstract_excerpt:
Continuing ideas of a recent preprint of Schwede arXiv:0906.4313 we study test ideals by viewing them as minimal objects in a certain class of $F$-pure modules over algebras of p^{-e}-linear operators.
